audit.why: 42.8% over 500 games with the chart even until Locke's first-item row; EVEN at 5.5/10 is defensible and the mirror reached the same read.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 and late spikes are built on Singed poisoning himself low.
audit.why: Poison Trail damages enemies in the path only — Singed takes nothing from it, so 'he poison-ticks himself low while running' is a fabricated spike. Insanity Potion is the real level-6 event on his side: 100s cooldown, combat stats, and Grievous Wounds applied through Poison Trail, which cuts the heal-back on Locke's W.
audit.corrected: Execute windows rekeyed to the trade you actually landed; Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds added to the late text. Chart rows unchanged — packet.levelChart, win[] and phases[].side already agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mega Adhesive is described only as a slow zone, and the Fling-into-goo root is never mentioned.
audit.why: Mega Adhesive grounds. Locke's E is his only dash and his only exit — standing in the vial means the button does not fire, which is the single most decisive interaction in this lane and it appeared nowhere. Fling also roots outright if it lands you inside the adhesive, chaining a 17/16/15/14/13s zone into his 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s flip.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated in whys[2], spikes[2], mid and wants.you[2]; the Fling-into-goo root stated in mid.

edits.before: Skill: level 3 stays even; his Mega Adhesive setups balance your Q burst.
edits.after: Skill: level 3 evens out — Mega Adhesive grounds your E out of the trade.

edits.before: Locke-favoured: your R (Purgatory) executes his low-HP poison retreats.
edits.after: Locke-favoured: your R (Purgatory) executes him through the retreat.

edits.before: Your spike: R (Purgatory) turns his low-HP escapes into a death sentence — a Singed who trades poison ticks and drops below the growing threshold gets executed even mid-flee.
edits.after: Your spike: R (Purgatory) turns his running escapes into a death sentence — the zone slows and executes, so a Singed you dropped below the threshold dies mid-flee instead of walking it off.

edits.before: After your first item your burst comfortably outpaces his poison DPS in a straight fight; just don't chase him through his W (Mega Adhesive) slow zone.
edits.after: After your first item your burst outpaces his poison DPS in a straight fight; just never chase through W (Mega Adhesive) — grounded, your E will not fire at all.

edits.before: Through 4-5 it stays even and comes down to whether you dodge his Fling and W (Mega Adhesive) setups. Use E (Ashen Pursuit) to bait the Fling, then commit — your grey-health steroid from W (Soul Ignition) lets you out-trade his poison in a short window.
edits.after: Through 4-5 it stays even and hinges on Mega Adhesive: it grounds, so E (Ashen Pursuit) cannot fire while you stand in the goo, and a Fling that drops you into it roots you outright. Step around the vial first, then commit with W (Soul Ignition) for the short window.

edits.before: At 6 you spike hard: R (Purgatory) executes a Singed who has poison-ticked himself low while running, flipping his signature escape into your kill. Beyond first item your burst wins the 1v1, but late-game he shifts to a run-it-down flinger, so late the lane is a wash decided by team peel.
edits.after: At 6 you spike hard: R (Purgatory) executes a Singed who took your trade and tried to walk it off, flipping his signature escape into a kill — but Insanity Potion applies Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail, so it cuts the heal-back on your W. Late he shifts to a run-it-down flinger and the lane is a wash decided by team peel.

edits.before: Hold R (Purgatory) for the moment his poison self-ticks him low on the retreat
edits.after: Hold R (Purgatory) for the retreat after your trade has dropped him low

edits.before: Avoid his W (Mega Adhesive) + Fling combo that sets up ganks
edits.after: Never stand in Mega Adhesive — grounded, your E cannot fire

notes: Two real errors. (1) Poison Trail does not damage Singed, so every line about him 'poison-ticking himself low' into your execute was invented — the execute window is the trade you landed, not his own poison. (2) Mega Adhesive grounds, and the page only called it a slow; grounded, Locke's E is dead, which is the decisive button in this lane. Also added Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail, which directly cuts the heal-back on Locke's W and was absent from the page.
